violation_type.title: Care Requirements for School-age - Caregiver Aware of Arrival/Departure (26 TAC §746.2701(4))
violation_type.short_title: Care Requirements for School-age - Caregiver Aware of Arrival/Departure
violation_type.typical_finding: When the elementary school sent a child to on site after school program by an error, the driver failed to confirm with the parent or the daycare center, if the child needed to be picked up by the daycare.

finding_variants.text: When the elementary school sent a child to on site after school program by an error, the driver failed to confirm with the parent or the daycare center, if the child needed to be picked up by the daycare.
A school age child as not accounted for after departing the vehicle and arriving to the classroom.

Due to a cellular power outage, the operation was not able to maintain their electronic attendance and did not have a backup attendance process in place to account for the children present preventing the operation from being aware of the arrival of children.
The operation failed to use their attendance taking system when children arrived from public school and were not aware that a school-age child did not get off the public school bus at the operation.
The driver was not aware of each child who ride the bus.
